articles.title: Coinbase backs Ethena ahead of savings product launch for exchange's 100 million users
articles.snippet: Coinbase Ventures, the exchange's venture arm, bought Ethena tokens on the open market as the protocol is set to roll out a Coinbase integration next week.

articles.title: As Strategy Sells Bitcoin, Strive Doubles Down With $4.2 Billion Offering
articles.snippet: Benchmark-StoneX analysts grew bullish towards Strive after the Bitcoin-buying asset manager padded cash reserves while growing its stockpile.

articles.title: Bitcoin Traders Flip Bearish as BTC Falls to Lowest Price in Months
articles.snippet: Myriad predictors think it's increasingly likely that Bitcoin's next stop is $55,000 rather than $84,000 as BTC continues its slide.

articles.title: Trump’s Business Partner Teases Future Meme Coin Plans: 'We’re The Biggest Brand on Earth'
articles.snippet: Bill Zanker, a longtime Trump associate, will take the top 19 holders of the president’s meme coin to the World Cup Finals next month—and has plans for ongoing exclusive events.
